# Tier `ampere-2x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda-pair` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 65536 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen38-27b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ3_S.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |
| `timestral-209m` | forecast | `forecast_model` | `timestral-209m` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

It ships no file-backed media seed, so `generate_image` / `generate_video` /
`generate_audio` / `run_graph` report `NOT CONFIGURED` until an operator binds them.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_max_tokens` | `1024` |
| `agent_model` | `qwen38-27b-pool` |
| `agent_profile` | `research` |
| `escalation_model` | `gemma4-31b-pool` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` | `1` |
| `reasoning_model` | `qwen38-27b-pool` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Two identical 16 GB Ampere cards (2x NVIDIA A2, sm_86, 15,356 MiB each, no NVLink) on a small-form-factor desktop, served as PIN, DON'T SPLIT for everything except the three POOLED seats: every other model fits one card and is pinned whole to it (llama-swap.linux-cuda-pair.yaml). HEAVY card: the Qwen3.8-27B agent (UD-IQ3_S) and the vision seat, one 12 GB model at a time. UTILITY card: the memory stack (embeddinggemma, reranker), STT, the forecaster, and the cascade (e4b | e2b | the 4B agent) as alternatives; the `both` set runs the cascade beside the 27B. POOLED seats span BOTH cards (layer split, equal tensor-split, `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<utility>,<heavy>` pinned explicitly) in their own sets beside the residents (the two Gemma pools beside all of them, whisper included; the 27B pool beside the memory stack and the resident seats except whisper, which a transcription request evicts), never beside the cascade or a single-card seat:qwen38-27b-pool (Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q6_K + MTP draft depth 3 + mmproj-F16, ctx 65536, the agent and reasoning seat), gemma4-26b-a4b-pool (QAT UD-Q4_K_XL + mmproj, ctx 32768) and gemma4-31b-pool (QAT UD-Q4_K_XL + mmproj, ctx 32768, the escalation seat). The single-card 27B (qwen38-27b-agent, UD-IQ3_S) and the 4B stay rendered as alternatives for when one card is busy. Card roles are a render-time choice, not a profile field: `install render --heavy-card N [--utility-card M]` (a CUDA index or a GPU-<uuid>; default heavy 0, utility 1; install.sh takes the same flags and OFFLOAD_HEAVY_CARD / OFFLOAD_UTILITY_CARD). Indices follow CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID, which gpu_env sets on every entry. The heavy card is a per-box choice because the two slots are not equal: on the reference box card 0 (CPU-lane slot, 60 W) was thermally limited by its chassis fan header, a host airflow fault and not a tier property, so the 27B ran on card 1 (chipset x4 slot, held at a 35 W floor) and its figures are a LOWER BOUND; a box with sound airflow renders heavy 0. MEASURED 2026-11-07 on that box (llama.cpp b12192 sm_86 CUDA 13.4, llama-swap v270): the 27B agent pinned to the 35 W card, 13,956 MiB, 8.4 tok/s generation and 42.5 tok/s prompt on a short prompt; offload-e4b 4,430 MiB plus embeddinggemma 452 MiB concurrently on the other card; whisper large-v3-turbo on CUDA 1,624 MB, an 11 s clip transcribed exactly in 6.7 s wall cold; timestral-209m 54.5 ms model wall, 934 MiB; every seat unloaded at ttl 300 (both cards back to 0 MiB, P8); doctor rc 0, acceptance READY. MEASURED 2026-11-07 on the same box for the POOLED seats (layer split, tensor-split 1,1, q8_0 K and V, flash-attn on): qwen38-27b-pool loaded in 18 s, 12,504 + 13,594 MiB, known-answer correct, decode 10.34 tok/s with MTP acceptance 293/465 (63 %), a 3,672-token prefill at 237 tok/s, resident beside the embedder through llama-swap (12,964 + 13,594 MiB), against 8.4 tok/s for the single-card 27B; `--split-mode tensor` decoded 10.71 tok/s but prefilled at 138 tok/s (and one card was throttled), so layer ships. gemma4-26b-a4b-pool: decode 11.92 tok/s, prefill 234 tok/s, 9,012 + 7,250 MiB, one card throttled (a lower bound). With the embedder, reranker and forecaster resident on the utility card: the 27B pool 12,516 MiB of share (utility card 14,230 of 15,356 MiB, other card 13,620 MiB), prefill 209.7 tok/s on a 3,668-token prompt, decode 8.1 tok/s, 1.1 GiB left on the utility card, less than whisper large-v3-turbo needs, so the 27B pool is not co-resident with whisper; the 26B-A4B pool 10,744 + 7,278 MiB, prefill 357 tok/s, decode 17.0 tok/s; the 31B pool 12,834 + 9,954 MiB, prefill 59 tok/s, decode 2.2 tok/s, a thermal artefact (the utility card throttled to 210 MHz at 86 C on a host cooling fault while the other held 1770 MHz) and not the seat's speed, so it awaits a measurement on a cooled pair; whisper loaded and transcribed beside the 31B pool plus all residents with no eviction. Ctx 131072 q8_0 for the cascade and the 4B, 49152 literal for the single-card 27B (the single-A2 fit, ampere-16), 65536 for the pooled 27B, which is the window agent_ctx_tokens advertises because the agent lane is bound to it. include_26b is false and moe_26b drops the single-card 26B: it measured 1/8 on the A2 (ampere-16); the pooled 26B-A4B is a different seat. The agent and reasoning seats are the pooled 27B and the escalation seat is the pooled 31B; the 4B remains the un-pooled fallback alias. PROJECTED, not measured on this tier: the vision seat (it is the ampere-16 bake-off's winner on the same silicon, never run on the two-card box), image input through the pooled seats' projectors (not part of the recorded runs), the pooled seats under real agent traffic, any concurrent load of the heavy seat with the cascade under real traffic, host RAM 32 GB (the reference box has 16 GB, ram tier min; at 32 GB it becomes low). No vLLM seat: no two-card vLLM measurement and no venv on the reference box (the ampere-16 vLLM seat is single-card, device 0). No comfy, image or video keys: the reference box has no ComfyUI install, so no image or video lane is declared until one is measured on this tier. Linux only (no Windows cuda-pair template); classification is gated to Linux.
